coverage.authoredAnalysis: Cover: Compromís and Sumar identities, Electoral23J and twelve proposed ministry agendas. This is a coalition programme, not an account of an existing cabinet; cover lacks an explicit year.

Education agenda, all twelve measures: State education investment7%GDP by legislature end; inclusive/coeducational and age-adapted sexuality education; language immersion protections in specified territories; publicly funded private schools subsidiary to public schools and no public-land grants to private centres; vocational-law reform; artistic/music higher-education access; lifelong adult education; participant involvement; university resource evaluation; income-related fees/grants paid at year start; stable research careers; increased research infrastructure/grants.

Housing/mobility, all twelve measures:30% of new construction protected affordable rental/sale housing,40% of that protected share for young people; transfer all SAREB homes to regional/local authorities; tackle housing harassment/discrimination; rehabilitation/self-consumption; supported housing for listed vulnerable groups; Valencian commuter-rail competence/budget transfer and specified extensions; Mediterranean and Sagunto-Zaragoza-Bilbao corridors, Valencia tunnel with protected orchard and Alicante station; AP7 access; stable metropolitan transport financing/intermodality; stop Valencia port expansion and use existing footprint; port competence roadmap. No general rent-price cap is stated on this page.

Culture/media, all twelve measures: equitable State cultural infrastructure funding; demilitarise/transfer SanDomènec convent; permanent Dama de Elche return; coofficial-language awards; lower cultural VAT and youth culture voucher ages16-30; cultural coordination table; broader non-profit educational/cultural copyright exceptions; reciprocal/regional public broadcasting throughout State, full Valencian territorialRTVE and multilingual broadcasts; professional information statute with sanctions/career expulsion for disinformation and CEMA regulator; territorial audiovisual promotion. Do not substitute party predictions or undefined sanction procedure for a precise quiz proposition.

Public administration/territory, all twelve measures: prefer public ownership/direct management and reduce outsourcing; official-language use; repeal CitizenSecurityLaw; abolish provincial deputations; Valencian coast/ports/airports/police transfers; debt-priority/audit proposal with questionable law identification; autonomous-region constituencies,400deputies, proportionality/zipper lists/voting16; youth bodies; referendums and easier legislative initiatives; annual accountability and parliamentary immunity limited to parliamentary task/time; corruption-whistleblower protection; abolish Senate and replace its territorial coordination function. Keep distinct decisions separate.

Inclusive/intergenerational policy, all twelve measures: State pays50%dependency-system funding to regions; prioritise elder home care; child voice; residence/work permits for formerly unaccompanied minors remaining in Spain after18; child-focused minimum-income access/budget; recognition of family forms/single-parent-large-family parity; birth/foster/adoption leave6months per parent and summed leaves for single parents; international adoption safeguards/LGBTI access; constitutional sign-language recognition with source language labels needing clarification; Romani language/culture; non-formal/volunteer skills accreditation; youth institute coordination.

Economy/work/social security, all twelve measures: minimum wage at least60%average Spanish wage; improve dismissal compensation and move toward32hours with unchanged salary; employment programmes for listed groups; labour inspection/conditional regional transfer; public pension constitutional protection and minimum pensions60%mean wage; food-producer price index and at least60%final food price to producer; rural livelihoods; review/reverse specified trade treaties when appropriate and exclude agri-food from extra-EU agreements; cooperative/social-economy finance; rural/out-of-season tourism; industrial infrastructure; stop large-store festive openings. Distinguish minimum-wage, pension and producer percentages.

Health/sport, all twelve measures: public health-management protection/universal access; Valencia displaced-patient debt/compensation; primary care at least25%total healthcare budget, funding region staff/infrastructure/material; remove pensioner medicine copayment with progressive remaining contributions; mental-health professionals/youth/education support; public-hospital abortion and free emergency contraception, support for gestational/perinatal/neonatal loss; more university/residency training; public pharmaceutical industry; public addiction-treatment capacity; health-impact assessments; elite athlete study compatibility and exercise prescription.

Climate/energy, all twelve measures: local self-consumption/communities and degraded-land solar; revoke macro-solar projects with adverse territorial/environmental reports and regional/local location participation; low-emission zones above50,000inhabitants with equity/shared electric rental; adaptation/rehabilitation support including100%aid for people who need it, with unspecified eligibility mechanism; Tajo-Segura resources with ecological flows/alternatives; water/energy rights and no supply cuts; coast infrastructure review; energy/water transparency; prohibit specified extractive techniques including fracking/rare-earth extraction and related gas imports; pollution/wastewater/waste control; eliminate short flights where a train under4hours exists; deposit-return/repairability; financed farm cage transition/hunting-dog protection/no public funding of bull shows involving animal death. No general nuclear position is inferred.

Tax/financing, all twelve measures: population/service-based regional financing and historical Valencian underfunding-debt forgiveness; population-weighted territorial investment/equalisation fund; progressive taxes with unspecified ordinary-income reductions; maintain graduated personal income tax, no precise new rates; progressive property-transfer tax up to11%for houses above1million euros; State inheritance/gift minimum rates with higher exempt minima; permanent wealth and extraordinary bank/energy-profit taxes; progressive corporate taxation/lower effort for lower-profit SMEs; speculative financial transactions tax; environmental revenues for transition; fiscal residence/worldwide taxation conditions for publicly supported State-representing athletes/artists; publicbank SME/household credit. Do not mislabel transfer tax as property-ownership tax.

Justice/security, all twelve measures: practical judicial/prosecutor entry exams, professional entry routes/resources; coofficial-language rights; regional judicial staff/account management and territorial court coordination; Valencian civil-law constitutional competence; gender-violence courts/mandatory judge gender training; judiciary council representation/independence wording without an exact election mechanism; disappeared-person census/maps and compatible relative DNA bank; end special Catholic fiscal privileges and repeal religious-offence crimeArticle525; more army emergency/humanitarian role and less weapons investment; parliamentary police-model commission.

Equality/LGBTI, all twelve measures: gender/intersectional budgets and policy; public/private decision-body parity; shared-care strategy; publish all wages/incomes/assets/taxes with unspecified privacy/scope mechanism; violence-budget/compensation parity with terrorism for defined death/severe disability cases including defenders/family; trafficking/reproductive exploitation prevention; equality agents/units; safeguard LGBTI laws/pact; commemorations/association support; international rights/diplomacy; justice/security training/report support; trans employment/social inclusion. Do not infer an undefined statutory quota or broad surrogacy legal model.

EU/external relations/migration, all twelve measures: rights/local participation; Agenda2030cooperation planning/civil participation; official development aid0.7%gross national income by2030; climate-refugee recognition; Sahrawi self-determination; regions participate respecting State diplomatic competences; international terrorism finance/sanctions; end specified coercive migration controls; immediate detention-centre closure and immigration-law replacement with citizenship rights, expulsions require court/hearing/lawyer/interpreter; asylum/legal support; sufficient asylum/police/immigration-office resources/training. End of document, no annex or footnote.
